snippet.title: Two-Player Online Roguelike Action Game I'm No Demonlord Demo Launches Today
snippet.description:
The demo of the brand new roguelike bullet hell shooter game I'm No Demonlord officially launches today on Steam, inviting players to dive into an exhilarating, action packed mowing down experience.
The demo offers substantial content, featuring 6 playable characters, 10 weapon types, and 13 skills, plenty to explore and enjoy.
Whether you are a lone wolf who prefers solo challenges or a team player who loves co-op sessions with friends, you will find your own way to have fun in the game.
